name: LIGHT IT
summary: 在纸艺风格棋盘放置发光水晶、照亮所有格子的逻辑解谜游戏。 开发者披露音乐使用 Suno，部分视觉素材使用图像生成工具，代码开发使用 AI 辅助构思与调试；游玩时不实时生成内容。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 开发者明确称游玩时不实时生成 AI 内容。
aiAreaNotes.code: AI 辅助提出实现思路和调试。
aiAreaNotes.art: 部分视觉素材使用 AI 图像生成工具。
aiAreaNotes.music: 游戏内音乐使用 Suno 生成。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: AI Generated Content Disclosure The developers of LIGHT IT provide the following disclosure regarding the use of AI tools in the creation of this game. All AI-assisted content is pre-generated; the game does not generate any AI content live during gameplay. Music: The in-game music was produced using Suno, an AI music-generation tool. Art: Some visual assets were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools. Code: AI assistants were used to help brainstorm implementation ideas and to assist with debugging. All AI-assisted content and code was reviewed, tested, and refined by the developer before being included in the final game.
